correctness.rationale: For the exact line graph L(GP(10,2)), independently constructed the dodecahedral 30 edges as the Rips vertex set, found 60 graph edges and diameter five. Exhaustive increasing-clique enumeration gives r1 (30,60,20), r2 (30,180,380,330,102), r3 (30,300,1340,3150,4374,3800,2100,720,140,12). Independently implemented legal elementary collapse selection on the full face sets; it found 468 r2 and 7,940 r3 free face-coface pairs, leaving at both thresholds 16 vertices, 42 edges, 28 triangular faces. Each residue has connected cyclic vertex links, coherent orientation, Euler characteristic 2, so is S2. Independently reconstructed both primitive integral oriented fundamental cycles and applied every r3 collapse chain map to the r2 generator: the resulting degree set is {+1}, establishing a genuine integral inclusion isomorphism, not a mod2 coincidence. At r1 each of 20 edge-disjoint triangles collapses, leaving rank 11 loops; at r4 the only missing edges form 15 disjoint antipodal pairs, yielding join of 15 S0=S14; at diameter-five scale a full simplex. Therefore the all-threshold integral homotopy and persistent intervals are established for this precise graph metric.
residual_risks: The construction and collapse proof are for graph shortest-path distance, not Euclidean metric or arbitrary dodecahedral line graphs.
The independent integral-chain calculation corroborates the original algorithm, but equivalent unindexed Rips computations remain a scholarly-priority risk.
